ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, water is transported from storage tank A into closed tank B by centrifugal pump $P_{1}$ with an efficiency of 75%. It is known that the characteristic curve equation of pump $P_{1}$ can be expressed as: $H=40-0.006q_v^2$ ($q_v$ is the volumetric flow rate, unit $m^3/h$). The maximum conveying capacity of this system is $50m^3/h$, and the pipe dimensions are all 108mm$\times$4mm. Assume that all flows are in the fully turbulent region; the distances between the outlet valves of the two pumps and the centrifugal pump outlets, and the distances between the outlet valves and the confluence point, are very short, and the resistance of the suction pipeline can be neglected. Find the resistance of the system when a single pump $P_{1}$ operates under the maximum flow-rate condition (expressed in m liquid column).

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the left side is storage tank A, the liquid level is marked as 0-0′, and the pressure inside the tank is marked as 0.1 MPa (gauge pressure); its liquid level height relative to the bottom datum is 5 m. The right side is closed tank B, the liquid level is marked as 2-2′, and the pressure inside the tank is marked as 0.2 MPa (gauge pressure). In the figure, the horizontal reference line near the pump outlet is 2 m from the bottom, while the liquid level of tank B is 10 m higher than this horizontal line, so the liquid level height of B relative to the bottom datum is 2+10=12 m. The pipeline sends water from A through centrifugal pump P1/P2 to B; in this problem, single pump P1 is taken to operate, and the endpoints of the energy equation are taken, according to the method, from the liquid level 0-0′ of tank A to the liquid level 2-2′ of tank B. Then reason: the maximum flow-rate condition is given as q_v=50 m^3/h. The characteristic curve of pump P1 is H=40-0.006q_v^2, so the pump head at this flow rate is H_p=40-0.006×50^2=40-15=25 m. The elevation difference between the two end liquid levels is z_B-z_A=12-5=7 m. The pressure-difference head is (p_B-p_A)/(ρg)=(0.2-0.1) MPa/(1000×9.81)≈100000/9810≈10.2 m water column. Write the energy equation from the A liquid level to the B liquid level: H_p=(p_B-p_A)/(ρg)+(z_B-z_A)+h_f. Substituting gives h_f=25-10.2-7=7.8 m liquid column. Therefore, the system resistance when single pump P1 operates under the maximum flow-rate condition is 7.8 m liquid column.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像并确定能量方程的两个端点为A槽液面0-0'和B罐液面2-2'。由文字给定最大流量条件取q_v=50 m^3/h，代入P1特性曲线H=40-0.006q_v^2，得泵在该点的扬程H_p=40-0.006×50^2=25 m。由图得高程差z_B-z_A=(2+10)-5=7 m，压力差水头(p_B-p_A)/(ρg)=(0.2-0.1)MPa/(ρg)≈10.2 m水柱。将这些代入H_p=(p_B-p_A)/(ρg)+(z_B-z_A)+h_f，解出系统阻力h_f=25-10.2-7≈7.8 m液柱。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧为贮槽A，液面标为0-0′，槽内压力标注为0.1 MPa（表压），其液面相对底部基准高度为5 m。右侧为密闭罐B，液面标为2-2′，罐内压力标注为0.2 MPa（表压）。图中泵出口附近的水平参考线距离底部为2 m，而B罐液面比该水平线高10 m，因此B液面相对底部基准高度为2+10=12 m。管路由A经离心泵P1/P2送至B，本题取单泵P1工作，能量方程端点按方法取A槽液面0-0′到B罐液面2-2′。
再推理：最大流量条件给定为q_v=50 m^3/h。泵P1特性曲线为H=40-0.006q_v^2，所以该流量下泵扬程为H_p=40-0.006×50^2=40-15=25 m。两端液面高程差为z_B-z_A=12-5=7 m。压力差水头为(p_B-p_A)/(ρg)=(0.2-0.1) MPa/(1000×9.81)≈100000/9810≈10.2 m水柱。对A液面至B液面列能量方程：H_p=(p_B-p_A)/(ρg)+(z_B-z_A)+h_f。代入得h_f=25-10.2-7=7.8 m液柱。因此单泵P1在最大流量条件下工作时系统阻力为7.8 m液柱。

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧为贮槽A，槽内液面附近标注压力为0.1 MPa（表），左侧高度标尺显示该液面相对底部基准为5 m。右上方为密闭罐B，罐内标注压力为0.2 MPa（表）；右侧高度标尺显示泵出口附近基准线离底部为2 m，上部到该基准线为10 m，因此按图中高程关系取B处液面高程为12 m。图中P1、P2两台离心泵并联后向B输水，本题要求单泵P1在最大流量条件下的系统阻力。

推理计算：按指定方法，系统静扬程截距为压力差水头与位差之和：H_static=(p_B-p_A)/(ρg)+(z_B-z_A)。压力差为0.2-0.1=0.1 MPa，折合水头约为0.1×10^6/(1000×9.81)=10.2 m；位差为12-5=7 m。所以H_static≈10.2+7=17.2 m。题给系统最大输送能力为50 m^3/h，单泵P1在最大流量条件下取q_v=50 m^3/h。代入泵特性曲线H=40-0.006q_v^2，得H_p=40-0.006×50^2=40-15=25 m。运行点满足泵扬程等于系统所需扬程，即H_p=H_static+H_res，因此系统阻力H_res=25-17.2=7.8 m液柱。

raw_record.original_question: 如图所示,用效率为75%的离心泵$P_{1}$将水由贮槽A处输送至密闭罐B内。已知泵$P_{1}$的特性曲线方程可以表示为:$H=40-0.006q_v^2$($q_v$为体积流量,单位$m^3/h$)。该系统的最大输送能力为$50m^3/h$,管路尺寸均为108mm$\times$4mm。假定所有流动均处于完全湍流区;两泵的出口阀门与离心泵出口距离、出口阀与汇合点之间距离很短,吸入管路阻力可忽略不计。试求单泵$P_{1}$在最大流量条件下工作时系统的阻力(用m液柱表示)。
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: in the figure, the left side is storage tank A, the liquid level is marked as 0-0′, and the pressure inside the tank is marked as 0.1 MPa (gauge pressure); its liquid level height relative to the bottom datum is 5 m. The right side is closed tank B, the liquid level is marked as 2-2′, and the pressure inside the tank is marked as 0.2 MPa (gauge pressure). In the figure, the horizontal reference line near the pump outlet is 2 m from the bottom, while the liquid level of tank B is 10 m higher than this horizontal line, so the liquid level height of B relative to the bottom datum is 2+10=12 m. The pipeline sends water from A through centrifugal pump P1/P2 to B; in this problem, single pump P1 is taken to operate, and the endpoints of the energy equation are taken, according to the method, from the liquid level 0-0′ of tank A to the liquid level 2-2′ of tank B.
Then reason: the maximum flow-rate condition is given as q_v=50 m^3/h. The characteristic curve of pump P1 is H=40-0.006q_v^2, so the pump head at this flow rate is H_p=40-0.006×50^2=40-15=25 m. The elevation difference between the two end liquid levels is z_B-z_A=12-5=7 m. The pressure-difference head is (p_B-p_A)/(ρg)=(0.2-0.1) MPa/(1000×9.81)≈100000/9810≈10.2 m water column. Write the energy equation from the A liquid level to the B liquid level: H_p=(p_B-p_A)/(ρg)+(z_B-z_A)+h_f. Substituting gives h_f=25-10.2-7=7.8 m liquid column. Therefore, the system resistance when single pump P1 operates under the maximum flow-rate condition is 7.8 m liquid column.
